texts.preamble: Kerala Merchants Union & Another vs State Of Kerala And Another on 22 July, 2021 Author: Murali Purushothaman Bench: Murali Purushothaman In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam Present The Honourable Mr.Justice Murali Purushothaman Thursday, The 22Nd Day Of July 2021 / 31St Ashadha, 1943 Wp(C) No. 5029 Of 2011 Petitioner/S: 1 Kerala Merchants Union A Society Registered Under Act 12 Of 1955, Having Registrationn No.104 E.R, Kerala Merchants Union Building, Post Box No.1101, Merchant Road Cochin-682 011, Rep By Its General Secretary, V.M.Siddique S/O.Late, V.A.Mohammed, Aged 36 Valiyara House, Pottakuzhi, Mamangalam Road, Kaloor, Kochi-17 2 V.M.Siddique, So.Late V.A.Mohammed Aged 36, Valiyara House,Pottakuzhi,Mamangalam Road, Kaloor,Kochi-17, General Secretary, Kerala Merchants Union By Advs. Sri.S.Sreekumar Sri.Aneesh James Sri.P.Martin Jose Sri.P.Prijith Respondent/S: 1 State Of Kerala And Another Secretary, Local Self Government Department, Government Secretariat,Thiruvananthapuram - 695 001 2 The Secretary To Government Health & Family Welfare Department, Government Secretariat,Thiruvananthapuram 695 001
texts.facts: The 1st petitioner is a registered Association and its members, including the 2nd petitioner, are engaged in the business of sale of food articles within the State. They have filed this writ petition challenging schedule I and II to the Kerala Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules, 2007 which prescribes much larger fees than what is prescribed under the Kerala Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules, 1957 towards licence fee and renewal fee. They have also challenged Ext.P3 Government Order GO.(MS)No.15/2008/H&FWD dated 09.01.2009 by which the imposition of licence fee under the 2007 Rules was frozen on condition that the applicants pay 25 times of the pre-existing licence fee and on further condition that the applicants file undertaking that they will pay the balance amount of WP(C) NO. 5029 OF 2011 ..3.. fees, if any, subject to the final judgment in W.P.(C) No. 12727/2007 and connected cases. 2. The petitioners have also relied on the interim orders in W.P.(C) No.11502/2010 and connected cases and this Court has passed a similar interim order dated 17.02.2011 in this writ petition staying the operation and enforcement of the schedules of the Kerala Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules, 2007 and Ext.P3 Government Order and collection of payments as per the said schedules and the Government Order.
